candidates.change_summary: Return the caller's address instead of the stored owner.
Return the contract's own address instead of the stored owner.
Remove the call to _transferOwnership(newOwner) so the owner never changes after transferOwnership.
Remove the zero-address requirement so ownership can be transferred to address(0), observable as owner() == address(0).
Transfer ownership to the caller (msg.sender) instead of newOwner, so the resulting owner differs.
Drop the _checkOwner() guard so any caller can execute transferOwnership and change the owner.
